metadata.question: Was the area of aritifical land built off the coast of Jakarata Bay greater than 800 hectares as of 2021?

data.raw_code: The user is asking about artificial land built off the coast of Jakarta Bay, specifically if it was greater than 800 hectares as of 2021. This requires: 1. Identifying artificial/built-up land in coastal areas near Jakarta Bay 2. Calculating the area of this artificial land 3. Comparing to 800 hectares For artificial land detection, I should use a land cover dataset. The ESA WorldCover dataset is good for this as it has a built-up class. I'll use the 2021 version. Steps: 1. Define the Jakarta Bay coastal area (using a polygon around the bay) 2. Use ESA WorldCover 2021 dataset 3. Extract the built-up class (class 50) 4. Calculate the area of built-up pixels 5. Compare to 800 hectares Potential issues: - If no WorldCover data exists for 2021 (unlikely, but possible) - C1 - If no built-up pixels found - could be valid (B) or C2 if no data at all - Area calculation returns None/NaN - C3 I'll use the ESA WorldCover v200 collection which has 2021 data. ```python import ee ee.Initialize(project='earthsense-436113') # 1. Geometry & Time Definitions jakarta_bay = ee.Geometry.Polygon([ [106.65, -5.95], [106.95, -5.95], [106.95, -6.25], [106.65, -6.25], [106.65, -5.95] ]) # 2. Data Acquisition - ESA WorldCover 2021 for built-up detection worldcover = ee.ImageCollection("ESA/WorldCover/v200").filterDate('2021-01-01', '2021-12-31') if worldcover.size().getInfo() == 0: print("No WorldCover data found for 2021.") print("C1") else: # Get the 2021 land cover image lc_2021 = worldcover.first() # Extract built-up class (class 50) built_up = lc_2021.select('Map').eq(50) # Calculate area in hectares (pixel area in m² / 10000) pixel_area = built_up.multiply(ee.Image.pixelArea()).divide(10000) # Calculate total built-up area area_stats = pixel_area.reduceRegion( reducer=ee.Reducer.sum(), geometry=jakarta_bay, scale=100, maxPixels=1e9 ) total_area = area_stats.get('Map').getInfo() pixel_count = built_up.reduceRegion( reducer=ee.Reducer.count(), geometry=jakarta_bay, scale=100, maxPixels=1e9 ).get('Map').getInfo() print(f"2021 Built-up area: {total_area:.2f} hectares") print(f"Valid pixels: {int(pixel_count)}") # Validation & Final Answer if total_area is None: print("C3") elif pixel_count == 0: print("C2") elif total_area > 800: print("A") else: print("B") ```
data.code:
import ee
ee.Initialize(project='earthsense-436113')

# 1. Geometry & Time Definitions
jakarta_bay = ee.Geometry.Polygon([
    [106.65, -5.95],
    [106.95, -5.95],
    [106.95, -6.25],
    [106.65, -6.25],
    [106.65, -5.95]
])

# 2. Data Acquisition - ESA WorldCover 2021 for built-up detection
worldcover = ee.ImageCollection("ESA/WorldCover/v200").filterDate('2021-01-01', '2021-12-31')

if worldcover.size().getInfo() == 0:
    print("No WorldCover data found for 2021.")
    print("<answer>C1</answer>")
else:
    # Get the 2021 land cover image
    lc_2021 = worldcover.first()
    
    # Extract built-up class (class 50)
    built_up = lc_2021.select('Map').eq(50)
    
    # Calculate area in hectares (pixel area in m² / 10000)
    pixel_area = built_up.multiply(ee.Image.pixelArea()).divide(10000)
    
    # Calculate total built-up area
    area_stats = pixel_area.reduceRegion(
        reducer=ee.Reducer.sum(),
        geometry=jakarta_bay,
        scale=100,
        maxPixels=1e9
    )
    
    total_area = area_stats.get('Map').getInfo()
    pixel_count = built_up.reduceRegion(
        reducer=ee.Reducer.count(),
        geometry=jakarta_bay,
        scale=100,
        maxPixels=1e9
    ).get('Map').getInfo()
    
    print(f"2021 Built-up area: {total_area:.2f} hectares")
    print(f"Valid pixels: {int(pixel_count)}")
    
    # Validation & Final Answer
    if total_area is None:
        print("<answer>C3</answer>")
    elif pixel_count == 0:
        print("<answer>C2</answer>")
    elif total_area > 800:
        print("<answer>A</answer>")
    else:
        print("<answer>B</answer>")
